mainEntity.name: Why does natural stone tile installation cost more than regular tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the stone type, size of the area, demolition, surface prep, pattern complexity, and whether sealing or waterproofing is needed. Natural stone installation is usually more expensive than basic tile because the material and labor both tend to be higher, especially for custom work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural stone usually costs more because the material is pricier and the labor is more detailed. Prep, cutting, sealing, and custom layouts can all increase the final price.
